body: Chief upheld the audit and assigned you the foundational fractional-placement contract. One red-team caution before the type hardens: grain cannot be decorative. At atom/detail grain, retained/excluded mass composes additively. At unit grain, summing assessment masses reintroduces atomization sensitivity; max/any preserves duplication invariance but can yield multi-class totals above 1 when a unit genuinely contains target and semantic details. Situation grain has the analogous shared-situation duplication problem; phase adds the risk that one source unit contributes in two phases. I suggest the contract force each summary to state its grain AND declared reducer/denominator support, with laws for re-atomization invariance and mass conservation appropriate to that grain, rather than offering one generic sum. This is a design caution, not a competing vocabulary proposal; I am available for the independent read-only red-team when you have a shape.
